description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LeavePeriodAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases verifying the API methods related to leave period data, such as retrieving one or all leave periods, and updating leave period information.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeavePeriodAPI functionalities, including getting leave periods and updating leave period data.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single leave period when data exists.

methods.name: testGetOneLeavePeriodUndefined
methods.description: Tests retrieving leave period data when no leave period is defined.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the getOne API method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of leave periods.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update function for leave period data, using data-driven test cases.
